$comment: ADR-0071 D4 — what every colour in the three lists is measured against, and its floor. `apps/web/src/lib/design-system/token-lists-contract.spec.ts` resolves each pair in light, dark and high contrast and fails on any pair under its floor, on any colour without a record, and on an unpaired colour that something uses. Floors: text and grounds 4.5 (WCAG 1.4.3), shapes 3 (WCAG 1.4.11). `exempt` carries the reason a colour has no floor; `unpaired` the reason it has no partner yet.

--color-surface-base.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the page ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-raised.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the card ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-sunken.basis: ADR-0059 D6; the recessed ground carries every text tier

--color-surface-skeleton.exempt: a placeholder ground for content still loading: it carries no text and bounds no control

--color-surface-overlay.exempt: a scrim colour, painted with an opacity where it is used; the text over it is measured with that opacity, against the worst admissible photograph

--color-text-disabled.exempt: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts the text of an inactive component; the dimming is the affordance

--color-text-inverse.unpaired: nothing uses it once both buttons take text.on-brand; the ground it inverts against is recorded at its first use

--color-text-on-brand.basis: ADR-0059; `colors.dark.json`: filled brand and semantic grounds keep their colour in every theme, so the text on them does not invert

--color-border-strong.basis: ADR-0066 D1; the edge of an object

--color-border-default.exempt: a rule between things that are not objects, never an object's edge

--color-border-subtle.exempt: a row rule inside a dense table, never an object's edge

--color-focus-offset.basis: ADR-0051; the halo is read against the ring beside it

--button-primary-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; measured at rest, on hover and pressed

--button-danger-text.basis: ADR-0071 D2; measured at rest, on hover and pressed

--button-disabled-background.exempt: WCAG 1.4.3 exempts an inactive component; opacity, cursor and aria-disabled carry the state with the colour

--card-border.exempt: the outline of a card that is not a control: WCAG 1.4.11 requires 3:1 of a control's boundary. The site's cards draw their edge in border.strong (ADR-0066 D1); the dashboard's uses of this token are a FOLLOW-UP in ADR-0071

--color-section-green-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-red-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-black-divider.exempt: a decorative rule, never a control boundary

--color-section-adjacent-separator.basis: ADR-0059 D2; the band between a green and a red section

--color-semantic-success.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge

--color-semantic-success-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-error.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge

--color-semantic-error-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; closes ADR-0067's DESIGN SYSTEM GAP semantic.error-text

--color-semantic-warning.basis: ADR-0051; ADR-0071 D1 corrects the light value

--color-semantic-warning-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-info.basis: ADR-0051; an icon or an edge

--color-semantic-info-text.basis: ADR-0071 D1; the state as text

--color-semantic-neutral.unpaired: nothing uses it; the light value measures 2.47:1 on surface.sunken, so its first use needs a pairing and a step that clears 3:1

--color-semantic-medal-gold.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints (700 on 50, 300 on the dark page), recorded at first use

--color-semantic-medal-silver.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints, recorded at first use

--color-semantic-medal-bronze.unpaired: nothing uses the flat value; ADR-0065 D2 measures the medal families as tints, recorded at first use

--color-item-1-surface.basis: ADR-0072 D1; an item card carries its title, its description and its ink on this ground, never the muted tier

--color-item-1-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-item-1-edge.exempt: an item card is not a control, so WCAG 1.4.11 asks nothing of its boundary, and light draws no edge (the card's own ground). Dark draws the ramp's 200 step, held at 3:1 or more on the page grounds and the green register by the item-colour part of token-lists-contract.spec.ts; high contrast draws it black at that theme's border width

--color-item-2-ink.basis: ADR-0072 D1; the number is text on its card, and the statement ordinals set the ink on the page grounds

--color-border-accent.basis: ADR-0072 D3; the accent rule is a non-text mark on the page grounds (WCAG 1.4.11)

--color-action-default.basis: ADR-0072 D13; the Action role as an edge or a glyph on the page grounds (WCAG 1.4.11); as a fill it carries --color-text-on-brand, recorded there

--color-map-marker.basis: ADR-0072 D13; the location pin is a meaningful non-text mark (WCAG 1.4.11), drawn under its label card on the base ground and over map imagery, which is not a theme colour
